notes: UNTESTED HYPOTHESIS PRESET: starting points for tuning (doc 55 section 4; D048 item 4). No value here has been run with this preset; status stays 'draft' until tuning, and becomes 'tuned' only after the sealed held-out rules PR1-PR7 pass.

Draft. Granite 4.1 3B has only doc 44's Ollama records (pick, fill, explain, text, knowledge); pick-hard and every llama.cpp arm are still to run, so this draft changes only what the Fill records show.
Non-thinking by design: no switch to send, nothing to check beyond thinking_chars = 0.

Fill: Granite left the place empty where the request named one (F02 and F04, all 6 samples) and got side right in 29 of 36 calls; so closed fields become per-field Picks and spans become a Pick over code-built candidates (request n-grams matched against island names).

Tuning arms, not draft values: greedy decoding (temperature 0, as Unsloth's guide suggests; the vendor ships no sampler) paired with one-pass letter scoring, since greedy K = 3 voting collapses to one answer; cards off on Pick (82 of 90 calls chose the same letter with and without cards, doc 53 section 2.4); cards through the template's documents path for Explain.
Schema mode: json_schema_strict, with a GBNF fallback if the dry run shows the role-token issue (llama.cpp issue 29006).
